say:1:1820216001:0.text: Lady Tephesia really went all out for Senea's performance, didn't she? She even had a special poster created for the show. They say it <style="highlight">looks different with each phase of the moon</style>.
say:1:1820216001:0.source_cn: 领主阁下为了塞涅的演出真是耗尽心思，连海歌剧院的演出海...

say:2:1820216002:1.text: Hmph. Her Ladyship really does think highly of her...
say:2:1820216002:1.source_cn: 哼，领主阁下还真是看重她……

say:3:1820216003:1.text: That much is certain. Before Senea, no Graveborn had ever risen to the ranks of nobility in just a few weeks.
say:3:1820216003:1.source_cn: 谁说不是呢。在塞涅出现之前，我可从没见过哪个亡灵能用短...

say:4:1820216004:1.text: But I don't mind it one bit. Thanks to Senea, we finally get to see something new at the theater after centuries.
say:4:1820216004:1.source_cn: 不过仔细想想也是。如果不是她的到来，海歌剧院的演出剧目...

say:5:1820216005:0.text: Don't even get me started on those actors. Same play this whole time, and somehow they still haven't gotten any better. Shameful.
say:5:1820216005:0.source_cn: 不仅剧目一成不变，连演技都毫无增长……以前那些演员真该...

say:6:1820216006:1.text: Now I get why Her Ladyship's doing everything she can to keep Senea in Novaris. She must've grown weary of the same old show herself.
say:6:1820216006:1.source_cn: 我忽然有点理解领主阁下的感受了。她应该也看腻了那些老套...

say:7:1820216007:1.text: I bet Senea stayed because Novaris is so close to the Lightbearer Empire. It's easy for stowaways to slip in and out.
say:7:1820216007:1.source_cn: 塞涅留下来的主要原因应该是这里离耀光帝国比较近，方便偷...

say:8:1820216008:1.text: If she went any further into Bantus, her only audience left would be those skeleton soldiers, cheering with their raspy voices and clapping with their withered hands.
say:8:1820216008:1.source_cn: 如果深入班题斯，恐怕只有军队里那些骷髅用粗哑的嗓子为她...
